# Independent terminal final-assignment exits

Java 8 instance/class initializers assign two original wide final fields with
three separate abrupt exits before/after the second store. A frozen external
IntConsumer observes every partial field state. Direct, compiled, reflection
and MethodHandle entries compare original exception identity, null-throw NPEs,
observer failures and sticky failed class initialization across two attempts.
Normal/reversed guard layouts each run with source/SDK Trace. D8 must retain
three independent linear throw blocks after the one original return. All Java,
original entries, metadata and Exceptions are checked. Six separately compiled
wrong programs change stores, exception identity or exit selection/effects.
